body:
Sandisk Corporation (SNDK) leads the S&P 500 in the last completed session, up +11.90%, followed by KLA Corporation (KLAC, +7.32%), Coherent Corp. (COHR, +6.60%) and NRG Energy, Inc. (NRG, +6.42%).
On the downside, lululemon athletica inc. (LULU) is the weakest at -17.38%, with Fair Isaac Corporation (FICO, -16.68%), Autodesk, Inc. (ADSK, -8.26%) and Adobe Inc. (ADBE, -6.73%) also under pressure.

### Sector Performance, Ranked Best to Worst [...] ## Market Pulse

The S&P 500 is trading lower in the last completed session at -0.39% (via SPY); a market-cap-weighted average of the 500 members reads -0.44%.
Market breadth shows broad weakness: 168 stocks advancing and 325 declining out of 494 constituents, with 1 unchanged.
Industrials leads the sectors at +0.45%, while Consumer Discretionary lags at -1.47%.
